notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote: The applicant shall have the right to appear before the Board to appeal the Board's decision.

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects
self-report.quote: (10) Maintain a record of all proceedings conducted by the Board and make available to licensees and other concerned parties an annual report of all Board action.

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: (b) All licenses shall expire three years after the date they were issued unless renewed.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that

boundary.quote_limits: The Board shall keep all information obtained pursuant to this section confidential.
